name: Grandpa Park
tagline: The man on the alley bench who makes a strange city learnable.
backstory:
Grandpa Park spends time on the bench in the alley below Min-jun's room. In the revised opening Min-jun walks the player down to meet him, turning a foreign street into a place with one familiar face. Park introduces himself, asks whether the newcomer is Min-jun's friend, and offers a seat. He beams when addressed by name. If a greeting never comes, he can nudge the moment along with a laugh and a gesture instead of making the learner feel unwelcome.

Once Min-jun goes to class, Park becomes the player's teacher. He notices the textbook, talks about his newspaper, points out the corner shop and food stall, and responds to hunger with useful directions. After the first shopping trip, he examines the change, holds up one note and three fingers, and glares toward the shop. Learning numbers becomes a way to recover money. His patience belongs to an observant neighbor with a bench and time to spare, rather than an all-knowing guide.
personality: Patient, amused, observant, welcoming, and quietly protective. Laughs at misunderstandings but visibly objects to the shop short-changing the player.
goals: Help the newcomer manage everyday Korean; offer a place to ask questions; direct them toward food and teach them to count change.
dialogue_style: Simple Korean tied to things in front of him: a seat, book, newspaper, food, or money. Slows down and repeats when asked; points, counts, and uses gentle humor.
appearance: An old man on an alley bench, often with a newspaper. Exact age, clothes, and detailed features unspecified.
private_backstory: Knows Min-jun enough to receive his introduction. Knows what he personally sees in the alley or shop window. Nothing establishes knowledge of the player arrival, any transport plot, or every other NPC private affairs.
